6.6 Bsw Module Entity Reference
An
AUTOSAR Basic Software Module
defines one or more
BSW module entities
.
A BSW Module Entity is a piece of code with a single entry point and an associate
set of attributes. In contrast to runnable entities which are exclusively scheduled by
the RTE only a subset of the BSW module entities, the
BswSchedulableEntity
s
and
BswCalledEntity
s are called by the
Basic Software Scheduler
. Others might
implement 'C' function interfaces which are directly called by other BSW modules or
interrupts which are called by OS / interrupt controller.
A
Basic Software Module Description
provides definitions for each
BswModuleEn-
tity
within the BSW Module. The
Basic Software Scheduler
triggers the execution of
BswSchedulableEntity
s and
BswCalledEntity
s in response to different
Bsw-
Event
s.
The
BswCalledEntity
s are triggered by
BswOperationInvokedEvent
s, the
BswSchedulableEntity
s by
BswScheduleEvent
s.
